name: Plau am See (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:4:1, with the figures of the city arms of Plau am See — a red castle with a black bull's head — on the yellow stripe.
history: The flag was executed by Manfred Kruse after a design by Heidemarie Ruchhöft, both of Plau am See, and approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 28 May 1996.

features.role: castle with bull's head from the city arms
